artifacts.summary: Confirms tutorial.md as primary seed doc, inventories stale vs. current claims across four markdown Lean guides, and documents the leansrc/sync-check conventions the new appendix must follow.

next_steps: Run /plan 620 to create the implementation plan for chapters/ax-lean-appendix.typ, using the section-to-source mapping in report section 5 and resolving the open items in report section 6 (appendix ordering, bibliography entry decision, compile-verification workflow, and locating a Derivable Prop counterpart to DerivationTree if one exists).

memory_candidates.content: BimodalLogic's typst/template.typ already ports LogosManual's #leansrc(module, name)/#leanref(name) helpers, and they are already used in chapters/p2-frame-classes.typ and chapters/p2-decidability-practice.typ (both #include'd by BimodalReference.typ). The pattern is #leansrc(...) followed by an unlabeled (no 'lean' tag) fenced code block containing the literal excerpt. Any future typst chapter adding a Lean source excerpt should follow this exact idiom rather than inventing a new code-block convention.

docs/user-guide/tutorial.md and docs/user-guide/quickstart.md in BimodalLogic are significantly stale against live FormalSystem/ source: wrong import name (import Logos / import Bimodal instead of import FormalSystem), Formula.atom takes an Atom not a String (use atomS or Atom.mkBase), DerivationTree constructors are snake_case (modus_ponens, temporal_necessitation) not camelCase, DerivationTree is now FrameClass-parameterized (DerivationTree fc Gamma phi), and .future/.past should be .always/.sometimes. docs/reference/tactic-reference.md was found current and well-maintained by contrast. Any task reusing these docs as seed material must re-verify every snippet against live source rather than copying verbatim.
